# shopify_fulfillment_service (Data Source)

Reads an installed fulfillment service by handle. Use it for services owned by Shopify (`manual`) or by other apps, which this provider doesn't manage, for example to reference the service's location. Fails if no service has the handle, and lists the handles that exist. Needs the `read_fulfillments` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A fulfillment service owned by Shopify or another app, which this provider doesn't manage.
data "shopify_fulfillment_service" "manual" {
  handle = "manual"
}

output "manual_location_id" {
  value = data.shopify_fulfillment_service.manual.location_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Handle of the service, e.g. `manual`. Matched exactly.

### Read-Only

- `callback_url` (String) URL Shopify calls for fulfillment requests, tracking numbers and stock. Null if the service has none, e.g. `manual`.
- `id` (String) Fulfillment service GID.
- `inventory_management` (Boolean) Whether the service tracks inventory and reports it to Shopify.
- `location_id` (String) GID of the location associated with the service. Null if there is none.
- `requires_shipping_method` (Boolean) Whether products must be physically shipped.
- `service_name` (String) Name of the service as merchants see it.
- `tracking_support` (Boolean) Whether the service supplies tracking numbers.
- `type` (String) `MANUAL`, `THIRD_PARTY` or `GIFT_CARD`.
